name: Fortra-Originated partner discount band (Non_Orig_* percents)
expected: On a Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated' PARTNER deal, the partner discount should be pulled from the Partner Pricing Model's Non_Orig_* (Fortra Orig) columns -> a LOWER band than channel-originated (catalog example 12% vs 20%). Net = List x (1 - Non_Orig_Discount%), and PDP for a Fortra-Originated line should DIFFER from the same partner's Channel-Originated PDP.
actual: Active V21 partner path is Deal_Type-BLIND. Live Force-reprice (isSuccess=true) of Fortra-Originated partner Discount quote 00781140 (BoKS Perpetual, partner=AB Test PPM-00028) stamped PartnerDiscountPercent=15 (Software_Percent__c CHANNEL column), Net=301.75=355x0.85, Src='System Calculated (Pre-Procedure, Percent Only)'. The SAME partner/product on a CHANNEL-Originated quote (00781388) also stamps PDP=15 -> Deal_Type has ZERO effect on the resolved percent. The Non_Orig_* band is never consulted: (a) active prehook is PartnerPricingPrehook V1 -> PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model,productType) which has NO dealType arg and unconditionally reads CHANNEL columns; the Deal_Type->Non_Orig routing exists only in the DORMANT PartnerPricingServiceV2/PartnerPricingPrehookV2; (b) V21 proc def has 0 references to Non_Orig columns; (c) ALL 30 Partner_Pricing_Model__c rows have NULL Non_Orig_* columns, so even V2 would resolve Fortra-Originated to 0% (net=list), still not the expected 12%.
evidence: Live reprice marker isSuccess=true Data/sc3473/e04_evidence/reprice_e04_resp.json ; Fortra-Orig quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC0000039bwH0AQ/view (BoKS Perpetual PDP=15 Net=301.75, Src 'Pre-Procedure, Percent Only' = V1) ; Channel-Orig control https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FO1u0AG/view (same partner BoKS Perpetual PDP=15) ; live class PartnerPricingService.cls L253-260 getMarginForProductType(model,productType)->Software_Percent__c (no dealType) ; V2 service PartnerPricingServiceV2.cls L123-129 (Non_Orig routing, dormant) ; V21 proc def Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition grep Non_Orig = 0 hits ; SOQL: 0 of 30 PPM rows have any Non_Orig_* populated.
defectStep: Not a V21 procedure step. Defect is in the Apex partner prehook layer that feeds PartnerDiscountPercent into V21: active processor = PartnerPricingPrehook V1 -> PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType(model,productType) is Deal_Type-blind (reads channel columns only). V21 'Partner Discount' / 'Resolve Partner Discount Percent' steps merely consume the pre-stamped PDP. Compounded by empty Non_Orig_* config on all PPMs.
proposedFix: (1) Wire the Deal_Type-aware processor (PartnerPricingPrehookV2 + PartnerPricingServiceV2, which already route Fortra-Originated -> Non_Orig_* via getMarginForProductType(model,productType,dealType)) into the active V21 plan in place of V1, OR backport the dealType/Non_Orig branch into the active PartnerPricingService.getMarginForProductType. (2) Populate Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Subscription_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Services_Pct__c / Non_Orig_New_Maint_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Ren_Maint_Pct__c on the partner pricing models (currently null on all 30) so Fortra-Originated deals resolve a real lower band. Note: V2 falls back to 0% on null Non_Orig, so the data backfill is required even after the wiring fix. DESCRIBED ONLY, not applied (validation-only; no deploy / no DML to config).
notes: Smoke-tested on real UI-hydrated records (no headless base-seed gap). Preflight passed: 00781140 is a UI-built Fortra-Originated partner Discount quote, CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing, valid active PPM-00028, BoKS Perpetual List=355. Branch confirmed via the V1-exclusive Src marker 'System Calculated (Pre-Procedure, Percent Only)'. This is distinct from E-03/SC-3359 (One-Time net zeroing) -- here the percent IS applied, it is just the WRONG (channel) percent for a Fortra-Originated deal. Consistent with E-01 (Fortra-Originated DIRECT skips partner steps) -- E-01 had no partner so net=list was correct; E-04 has a partner so the Non_Orig band SHOULD apply but does not. Catalog's mechanism (Non_Orig column set) is genuinely implemented but only in dormant V2 code + the data is empty; a real partner-ops user building a Fortra-Originated partner quote in the UI hits the same gap (gets channel discount, not the lower Fortra-Orig band). Reportable defect.
verdict_reason: Fortra-Originated partner deals resolve the CHANNEL discount (PDP=15 identical to channel-originated), never the Non_Orig_* band, because the active V21 partner path uses the Deal_Type-blind PartnerPricingPrehook V1 and all 30 PPMs have null Non_Orig columns -- the expected lower Fortra-Orig band is not applied.
